senses.gloss: c. Ḳoshṭ (costum, κοστός), name of a fragrant root or shrub, putchuck.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:5">Ukts. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 51b">Nidd. 51ᵇ</cite>; Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᶜ <he>כוש׳</he>; Y. Erub. IX, end, 25ᵈ <cite ref="K00411"><he>כּוֹשְׁתְּ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 107">Sifré Deut. 107</cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 6a">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; Y. Yoma IV, 41ᶜ (one of the ingredients of frankincense). Ch. <cite ref="K01332"><he>כָּשַׁרְתָּא</he></cite>.
